result.brief: 提出长时多镜头视频编辑框架 MoviEdit：级联双向-自回归架构在压缩时空表征上建立全局一致草稿再自回归细化，并配套 87K 配对数据生成管线与 MoviEdit-Bench 评测基准。
result.reason: Long-form multi-shot video editing with cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive modeling over compressed spatiotemporal representation, plus data pipeline and benchmark; directly serves video editing/generation.
